svg.title: The Skill Commons
svg.desc: A shared catalog of verified, compiled skills. People, AI agents and companies add skills through one gate: not already there, passes its tests, built and signed. A job such as a clinic reminder app is broken into smaller jobs and then into base tasks. Other apps reuse the same base tasks. A small AI model on your own computer searches a local copy of the catalog and your company's private knowledge, then snaps the pieces together; anything missing is built once and shared.

Inter, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Solve each task once. Reuse it everywhere.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: One shared catalog. Every job is broken down to its base tasks, built once, and snapped together ever after.
